items.instruction: Click the sort arrow in the Amount column header.
Click the edit button on the row for the Coastline Rail expense.
Click the delete button on the row for Maya Okafor's Copperpot Bistro expense.
Go to the next page of rows.
Export this view as a CSV file.
Open the receipt for the Kestrel Learning expense.
Tick the row checkbox for Daniel Reyes's Software expense.
Open the filter options for this view.
Click the box for searching the expenses.
Add a new row to the expense table.

items.question: What is the amount of the Pinecrest Suites expense? Answer with just the amount.
Among the rows on this page, which employee has the largest single expense (by Amount)? Answer with the name only.
How many rows on this page have the status Pending? Answer with just the number.
What is the sum of the Amount of all Travel rows on this page, whatever their status? Answer with just the amount.
Among the rows on this page with the status Rejected, what is the earliest date? Give it exactly as shown in the Date column.
Which employees have at least one Rejected expense on this page? List their names separated by commas.
items.answer: Daniel Reyes, Maya Okafor, Priya Natarajan
